title: gagea bracteata
intro: Gagea bracteata, commonly known as the little yellow or green-flowered Gagea, is a species of flowering plant in the lily family. It has been traditionally used in medicine due to its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gagea bracteata include wound healing, anti-bacterial, and anti-fungal activities, making it a potential treatment for skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of Gagea bracteata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
